system.description:
You weave summoning seals together, infusing an echo of the Reapers black chakra and have it coat a weapon you are holding.

For the duration, the weapon you affected by this has its damage die become 1d12 Necrotic damage. If a creature you dealt damage to with this weapon would regain hit points before the end of their next turn, they instead take Necrotic damage equal to the amount of hit points they would regain. This can trigger once before the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, a creature cannot gain temporary hit points until the end of their next turn. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, a creature regaining hit points, can trigger the necrotic damage twice.
